ngaap.notes: Q2-14 release did not publish an adjusted EPS; it said EPS of $0.35 'includes costs of $0.02 per diluted share related to acquisition and divestiture activity'. The adjusted figure $0.36 (+$0.01 items) is from the Q2-15 release's prior-year comparison. Cash gross profit per ton $5.00 from release text. Vulcan's EBITDA reconciliation = net earnings + provision for income taxes (continuing ops) + interest expense, net + (earnings) loss on discontinued operations net of tax (extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops, signed as added) + DDA&A (EBITDA excludes discontinued operations). Hence self-check ni_vulcan + ebitda_bridge_tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub differs by the after-tax discontinued-operations add-back (0.5); not an extraction error.

check_notes: Self-check results: EBITDA check (ni+tax+interest+dda) is off by the discontinued-ops add-back 0.5; passes once ebitda_bridge_disc_ops is included (Vulcan definition, see ngaap.notes). All other checks pass.
